spec.name: Orange Kitchen Chocolate Doughnut
spec.description: A golden baked doughnut with a genuine open center, stepped round silhouette, thick chocolate glaze, uneven drips and seven ivory and caramel sprinkles. Ground contact is at y=0.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. Create Chocolate Doughnut. A ring-shaped glazed doughnut with a real open hole, uneven icing drips and small sprinkles. Use stepped rounded geometry. Actual recipe ingredients: glazed doughnut, chocolate. Let the visible appearance reflect these ingredients.
